hebrewText: כַּ/מַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְ/הִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥/י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּ/י כַּ/דּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽ/י

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.explanation: mayim — água, rio, mar (sempre plural em hebraico)

tokens.bdb: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
tokens.kjv: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

tokens.bdb: to break through, i.e. spread or separate (oneself)
tokens.kjv: disperse, divide, be out of joint, part, scatter (abroad), separate (self), sever self, stretch, sunder.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
tokens.kjv: body, bone, [idiom] life, (self-) same, strength, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
tokens.kjv: [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.explanation: lev — coração, mente, vontade, centro da vida interior
tokens.explanationEn: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings

tokens.bdb: to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief)
tokens.kjv: discourage, faint, be loosed, melt (away), refuse, [idiom] utterly.

tokens.bdb: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).

tokens.bdb: used only in plural the intestines, or (collectively) the abdomen, figuratively, sympathy; by implication, a vest; by extension the stomach, the uterus (or of men, the seat of generation), the heart (figuratively)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: used only in plural the intestines
tokens.enLiteralWord: used only in plural the intestines
tokens.explanation: used only in plural the intestines
tokens.explanationEn: used only in plural the intestines
